questions.q: Which club did goalkeeper Paul White join Kettering Town from in 2016?
questions.note: White signed from Accrington Stanley and has since passed 150 appearances for the Poppies.

questions.q: Kettering Town were the first club in England to do what, in January 1976?
a: Wear a sponsor's name on their shirts
questions.note: Kettering Tyres appeared on the shirts against Bath City on 24 January 1976, a first in English football.
